PLAINTIFF’S NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT

Please take notice that Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine, pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil
Procedure 78 and Local Civil Rule 7, does not request oral argument on the Motion to Dismiss of
Defendant National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (ECF No. 10), noticed for hearing on
September 30, 2026 (ECF No. 38), and submits that Motion for decision on the papers.

Plaintiff likewise does not request oral argument on the Motion to Dismiss of Defendant
Meta Platforms, Inc. (ECF No. 21), as to which Meta Platforms, Inc. has filed its own waiver of
oral argument (ECF No. 23), and submits that Motion for decision on the papers.

This Notice does not excuse Plaintiff’s appearance at any scheduled hearing. Unless and

until the Court vacates the September 30, 2026 hearing, Plaintiff will appear as ordered.
